## About this natok
Tor Preme Pagol follows two people who keep meeting at the wrong moment, in a small town that never quite lets them go.

## Cast and crew
- Musfiq R. Farhan
- Keya Payel
- Directed by Toufiqul Islam

## Where to watch
The full natok streams here on the official archive, and on the official YouTube channel.
